title: Package dependency
description:
Because of the imported packages (`dplyr`, `magrittr`, and `rlang`), it takes a long time to install `hcandersenr` via `devtools::install_github("EmilHvitfeldt/hcandersenr")`.

I guess allowing `hca_fairytales.R` to live in a `data-raw` folder could reduce the dependency? That is, maybe `hca_fairytales` could be another `rda` file?
